prerequisites.title: Xero App Partner Program application
prerequisites.detail: You must apply to join the program and complete certification before you can qualify to list. Xero's acceptance criteria were not found.

prerequisites.title: Sign Up with Xero implemented
prerequisites.detail: This must be done before you submit the listing for review. Sign in with Xero also covers the minimum two-step authentication requirement.

prerequisites.title: Own client ID and secret
prerequisites.detail: Composio has no managed Xero app, so register your own OAuth app and supply its credentials.

steps.title: Create Xero OAuth app
steps.detail: Log in to the Xero developer portal and create an app to get a client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Check and register redirect URI
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard. Check it is absolute, has no wildcards and the app stays within 50 URIs.
steps.done_when: The redirect URI is saved in the Xero app.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API with your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and a test connection works.

steps.title: Apply to App Partner Program
steps.detail: Submit the company application and start certification.
steps.done_when: Xero confirms your application or acceptance.

steps.title: Implement Sign Up with Xero
steps.detail: Draft and wire up the Sign Up with Xero flow before the listing is submitted.
steps.done_when: Sign Up with Xero works end to end in testing.

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Prepare answers on authentication, encryption, audit logging and personnel security from your documentation.
steps.done_when: A draft is ready for your review.

steps.title: Submit assessment and listing
steps.detail: Complete the assessment, write clear listing information and submit both to Xero.
steps.done_when: Both are submitted in the Developer Centre.

steps.title: Wait for Xero's review
steps.detail: Xero emails whether you passed. If not, you get a remediation report.

steps.title: Remediate if not passed
steps.detail: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days and implement changes within 60 days. Xero then re-reviews.
steps.done_when: Xero's re-review confirms the standards are met.

traps.title: No Composio managed app
traps.detail: You cannot prototype on a Composio-provided Xero app, so own credentials are needed from the start.

traps.title: Assessment is annual
traps.detail: The security assessment must be repeated every year, so plan for recurring work.

traps.title: Advanced assessment at 1000 connections
traps.detail: Reaching 1000 or more connections requires an advanced assessment, also reviewed by Xero.

traps.title: Some APIs are always assessed
traps.detail: All consumers of the Practice Manager, Xero HQ and Xero Tax APIs are affected. Xero can also require an assessment for any other consumer.

traps.title: Refresh tokens expire after 60 days unused
traps.detail: Users must then reauthorise the app. A refresh with no response can be retried with the same token for up to 30 minutes.

traps.title: Remediation can add up to 90 days
traps.detail: A failed assessment gives you 30 days for a plan and 60 days to implement, before re-review.

traps.title: Subscriptions limited to three regions
traps.detail: Xero App Store Subscriptions customers are currently in Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom only.
